H,W=26,22
g=[[8]*W for _ in range(H)]
# Define tile regions and repeated source patterns
regions=[(2,3,9,6,[[0,1,0],[1,0,1],[1,1,0]]),
         (4,13,8,6,[[4,0],[4,4]]),
         (16,3,6,8,[[3,0,3,3],[0,3,0,3],[3,3,0,3]])]
